                    for f in sorted_f:
                        if f < time: best_f = f
                    return motion[eid][best_f] if best_f is not None else None
                else:

                    for f in sorted_f:

                    return motion[eid][best_f] if best_f is not None else None

            s1_pre = get_state(id1, t, True)
